explanation: The lemma says equality of the quotient classes `homMk f` and `homMk g` is equivalent to `HomotopicL f g`. It holds because of how the library defines `HomotopyCategory₂` and `homMk`. `HomotopicL` appears only in `Mathlib/AlgebraicTopology/Quasicategory/TwoTruncated.lean`, so no other declaration can state this result. The proof is only `Quotient.exact` and `Quotient.sound`, which are generic quotient principles. I searched the Quasicategory directory for `homMk_eq_iff` and `HomotopyCategory₂`, and all of Mathlib for `HomotopicL`. I found no other declaration with this content.
